The '''Auratera system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]] and its dual [[Star/Legends|stars]], [[Aurell/Legends|Aurell]] and [[Ryern/Legends|Ryern]].<ref name="NoP" />
